note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), read offline from the bundled owb-am text, per the founder decision of 2026-11-18 that every Amharic work quotes OWB. Every quotation was re-quoted to it verbatim, replacing the 1962 UBS wording: Wesley's cited verses and the long passages he quotes from his own sermons and hymns alike. Wesley weaves Scripture into his sentences inside ‹ › marks; where OWB's words can stand in his sentence they now do (moving the mark so that only OWB's words sit inside it, as in Sermons on Several Occasions, #9908), and where he re-personed a verse into his own grammar ('the mind which was in Christ', 'they purify themselves') the marks were removed and the phrase stays his.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in that block: the whole verse or range, the shortest contiguous span carrying the quoted clause, or exact OWB pieces joined with '…'. `self_rendered` rows (each with a `why`) are allusions, Wesley's re-personed weavings and bare citations. Decisions reused from #9908: 1 John 3:9 'doth not commit sin' stays rendered from the English where Wesley argues against the 'continue in sin' reading (decision doth-not-commit-sin); 'perfect' where OWB reads 'mature' carries the gloss ማለትም ፍጹም (Ephesians 4:13 'a perfect man'); 'pray without ceasing' is OWB «መጸለይን አታቋርጡ»; 'Thy will be done' follows OWB Matthew 26:42 «ፈቃድህ ይሁን».
